statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-8534 is a NULL pointer dereference in PS_Lvl2page() in tools/tiff2ps.c of LibTIFF, reached when the tiff2ps command-line tool converts a crafted TIFF file whose strip or tile byte counts cannot be read (https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/issues/718). Upstream fixed it for LibTIFF 4.7.1 in merge request https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/merge_requests/746 with commit https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/commit/6ba36f159fd396ad11bf6b7874554197736ecc8b, which makes tiff2ps check that the byte counts were read before using them. Debian has not fixed trixie's 4.7.0-3+deb13u3 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-8534). The DHI tiff package for Debian 13 is built from that Debian version with this upstream change backported. Its current build, the fixed version in this range, lists CVE-2025-8534 in its shipped changelog, and its tiff2ps program for amd64 and arm64 contains the error messages the fix adds ("Can't read bytecounts of tiles at PS_Lvl2page()"), which the tiff2ps in Debian's own 4.7.0-3+deb13u3 lacks. Builds before the current one are no longer published in the DHI Debian repository and could not be checked, so this range treats them as affected.
